status: Proposed CPU callback-gradient patch only; not applied/built/run/hashed/committed. Root must full-read before application.
supersedes: Unapplied r1 patch is retained but withdrawn: it put NoSlip/ncomp/component physical semantics in the generic MLS helper. Do not apply r1.
actual_callers: Five distinct writers and 15 call statements: pressure1, SPR velocity2, dynamic state4, matrix4, Ace4. Only the five lambdas need the additional internal callback parameters; the InterpolateBoundaryGhostFieldT function declaration/call arguments and header do not change.
generic_change: Use the existing gradfieldx/y/z RHS storage after finishing each component inverse calculation to pass its physical fitted gradient (-qx,-qy,-qz) to write(p,value,gradx,grady,gradz). No new array, loop, neighbour pass, physical NoSlip/field-number test or runtime state is introduced in MLS. Zeroth-order fallback passes null gradient pointers. Dynamic wall already rejects non-first-order fits before its writer, so its NoSlip branch needs no additional fallback/check. Four non-consuming writers use unnamed gradient parameters.
field_arithmetic: Existing qg, anchored mirror value and shifted-target expression groups are retained. qx/qy/qz declarations move just outside the shifted/dynamic branch to produce the callback gradient; they are stored only after their current component value is finished. Different components have independent RHS entries. Unused gradient work can be removed by the compiler for writers that ignore it; actual build/timing is not asserted.
scope: src/source/JSphCpu.cpp only if later applied. Existing private fixed parallel axis-plane fixture only; InitDynamicPoreWallCpu still explicitly rejects NoSlip at public/normal initialization. No public guard removal, new API/array/flag, neighbour pass, corner, unsupported-wall, motion or plasticity admission.

legacy_actual_read.selection: InteractionMdbcCorrectionT2:3057 selects per-particle boundslipmode if present, otherwise template/global slip. Proposed dynamic state uses existing BoundSlipModec with SlipMode fallback.
legacy_actual_read.velocity: Legacy NoSlip :3339-3344 forms v2=2*motionvel-velrhopfinal then calls Mdbc2TangenVel; it does not overwrite the physical boundary XYZ velocity. For the admitted stationary wall, image=-v_mirror and viscous scratch=Pt*image. New derivative scratch receives the full image; physical Velrhop remains (0,0,0,RhopZero). Mdbc2TangenVel :3030 is reused, including its existing float projection arithmetic.
legacy_actual_read.stress: Legacy :3230 uses dpos=-boundnormal; sigmafinal is ghost sigma plus its fitted physical gradient dot dpos, then assigned unflipped to sigma at :3344. Merely copying the dynamic mirror-point sigma would NOT reproduce this evaluation location.
legacy_actual_read.precision_limit: Legacy velocity interpolation is zeroth order and its temporary sigmafinal is float. The dynamic candidate retains its current first-order anchored double reconstruction and double stress state. This patch reuses the location/sign/tangential-slip policy, not a bitwise numerical clone of legacy interpolation.

state_policy: All NoSlip policy stays in ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu writer. Select existing BoundSlipModec or SlipMode fallback. sigma_B=sigma_mirror-grad_sigma dot boundnormal, with no FreeSlip shear sign. Derivative image=-v_mirror, viscous scratch=Mdbc2TangenVel(raw,image), physical fixed velocity unchanged. FreeSlip three arithmetic statements are retained verbatim in else. J/p normal head, geometric C and Darcy-Ace are unchanged.
stress_theory_limit: Extrapolating stress without the FreeSlip shear sign is the retained legacy discretization policy. It permits nonzero wall shear; it is not a theorem specifying the correct ghost stress for every arbitrary NoSlip deformation field. In particular L_b=R_v*L_g*Q does not imply one universal QsigmaQ stress parity for NoSlip.
zero_step_plan: Use real zero-g retained parallel FreeSlip initialization, then explicitly set the existing per-MK/per-particle slip selector to NoSlip in a private zero-step fixture. No public guard deletion. Test global fallback and per-MK override separately, with FreeSlip control unchanged.

Reuse current Wendland/Cubic coincident and exact dp/8 target fixtures and original td=32768*DBL_EPSILON*condition, tf=64*FLT_EPSILON*condition field budgets. Affine all-six stress fields must match their values at actual boundary coordinates, not mirror coordinates; affine nonzero xz shear exposes both a missing extrapolation and an erroneous FreeSlip sign. A constant nonzero xz shear witness must survive with the same sign at a NoSlip boundary.

Check full derivative image and legacy tangential image independently with nonzero normal plus tangential input velocities; keep physical XYZ zero and rho fixed. Raw C must retain Q*C*Q, normal hydrostatic p/J and Darcy Ace must retain the already validated geometric rules; velocity image signs must never be reused for these fields.

Retain full native-field/ID/geometry/no-step assertions and original FreeSlip zero-g/tangential-g byte regressions. The candidate adds no new half-step chain or long solver run. A zero-step manufactured affine transfer is not a global NoSlip mechanical solution.
bounded_mechanical_plan: After zero-step implementation checks: a short elastic saturated SH pulse or eigenmode, no HG/damping/plasticity/body force/load/drain changes, constant k and stable existing natural-step limit. A stationary NoSlip wall should reflect transverse velocity with sign reversal and shear traction with same sign; the FreeSlip control has the opposite reflection signs and zero surface shear. Measure actual incident/reflected characteristic histories, native p/J/energy and pair-force wall reaction before a wave returns from the opposite boundary. Keep existing finite/no-exclusion/natural-step and <=1.1 pulse-energy guard; establish reaction tolerance from the independent same-stage pair-force roundoff/quadrature reference before running, not from an assumed exact continuum resultant. Stationary-wall zero power is necessary but alone vacuous for reaction accuracy. Do not infer mechanical acceptance just because derivative velocity matches its imposed mirror.
limits: No public initialization guard removal, NoSlip physical admission, corner/inactive wall/motion/plasticity extension, GPU patch, solver/integrator test or new half-step chain. Gradient callback is internal and does not add a public option or allocated state.
